title: 社交关系图
problem_statement_md:
你正在编写一个社交网络类**X**。

用户之间的关系存储在**图**中。
给出的代码声明**X**类，其中有**add_friend**()方法，并为5个用户创建关系。

输入一个数字表示某个用户，并输出相应用户的好友数。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Graphs[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are making a social network called [b]X[/b].
Connections between the users are stored as a [b]graph[/b]. 
The given code declares an [b]X[/b] class with its [b]add_friend[/b]() method and creates some connections for 5 users.

You need to take a number as input and output the number of connections of the corresponding user.
[note]Each user's connections are stored in the [b]adj[/b] matrix.[/note]
hint_md: 每个用户的连接都存储在**adj**矩阵中。
